title: Inference error dimension index and resolution playbook
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a multidimensional error dimension index and accompanying interactive dashboard + playbook that unifies timeout, overload, model, and transport (HTTP/gRPC) failures. The goal is to give SREs, oncall, and platform owners a single pane for root-cause triage that ties traces, metrics, and logs into named failure modes and recommended remediation steps.
acceptance_criteria: A dashboard that surfaces top 10 error modes by count, p50/p95 latency, and % customer queries impacted for the last 24h and 7d
Tracehook enrichment implemented: failure_mode, failure_stage, model_variant, kv_cache_hit, queue_depth, and upstream_error_code attached to spans for sampled requests
Mapping table that converts HTTP/gRPC status codes + runtime signals into taxonomy categories (timeout, overload, model_error, transport_error, auth) documented in Confluence
Playbook entries (triage steps + runbooks) for each major taxonomy bucket accessible from the dashboard
Synthetic probe integration showing end-to-end timeout vs server-side timeout attribution
Automated alerts for error-mode regressions using baseline-aware thresholds (configurable per-customer tier)
work_notes: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with SRE, runtime, and console teams. Agreed on taxonomy buckets: frontend_timeout, router_timeout, runtime_timeout, model_hang, model_reject, overload_queue_drop, grpc_status_non_ok, http_5xx, auth_failure.

2025-02-13: Prototype tracehook semantic keys. Chose 6 canonical keys to avoid tag explosion: failure_mode, failure_stage, failure_signature_hash, backend_node_id, concurrency_bucket, cold_start_flag.

2025-02-14: Decision: implement failure_signature_hash computed deterministically from (stage + canonical_message + model_variant) to group model errors without leaking PII. Trade-off: loses some free-text fidelity but avoids sensitive content in traces.

2025-02-15: Backend telemetry changes required: add aggregate counters for queue_depth buckets and kv_cache_hit ratio per route. Eng infra will add two Prometheus metrics: ri_route_queue_depth_bucket and ri_route_kv_cache_hit_ratio (labels: route, model, region).
2025-02-16: Dashboard wireframe review with PM and Design. UX request to support pivoting by customer_id or model_variant, with rate-limited lookups to avoid PII exposure in shared dashboards.
2025-02-17: Started implementing dashboard panels + mapping layer. Initial SQL for error-mode rollup created in BigQuery. Need to add synthetic probe time attribution joins next sprint.
2025-02-18: Noted blocker: runtime team needs to expose precise stage-level latency buckets for model init vs token-generation to attribute timeouts correctly. Opened ENG-475832 to track that work.
comments: Aisha Khan (2025-02-13): Prefer grouping model errors by canonical signature hash to reduce noise from regression messages. Avoids exposing prompt contents.
Priya Patel (SRE) (2025-02-14): Add a panel that shows latency attribution by hop (load-balancer, router, runtime, model). We often see skewed p95 driven by router retries.
Tomás Rivera (2025-02-15): Implementation note - will add failure_mode tag in tracehook only for sampled traces, and export aggregated counts via metrics for full-sample rollups.
Design review (2025-02-16): UX wants a matrix view: rows = failure_mode, columns = failure_stage; cell = impact score (customer-queries * p95 / baseline).
SRE (2025-02-18): Reminder to include noise-reduction heuristics to avoid alert fatigue; propose suppression when a single customer causes >80% of errors for a route.
